order_wins: **NCC** — receives a **Rs 1,286.03 crore (excl. GST) Letter of Acceptance from Hyderabad Growth Corridor** to build Package-1 (Budwel to Shabad) of Radial Road-2 on NH-167N, Telangana, over 18 months _(~16.1% of mcap)_.

**KEC International** — wins **orders of Rs 1,030 crore**: a 400 kV line in Bhutan, a further 380 kV line in Saudi Arabia, tower supply in the Americas, a 300+ MW wind EPC order and cables _(~10.7% of mcap)_.
**Pace Digitek** — receives a **Rs 1,794 million LoI from BSES Rajdhani** for a 57.5 MW/115 MWh battery storage system at four grid stations, due in 28 weeks _(~5.0% of mcap)_.
**EMS** — receives a **Rs 129.80 crore (incl. GST, excl. O&M) Letter of Award from Municipal Corporation Jodhpur** for AMRUT 2.0 sewerage works over 24 months, with 10 years of O&M _(~7.1% of mcap)_.

**Interarch Building Solutions** — wins a **~Rs 59 crore (incl. taxes) pre-engineered steel building order** from an undisclosed customer for an electronics manufacturing unit in South India, with 25% advance _(~2.1% of mcap)_.

**DEE Development Engineers** — subsidiary DEE Fabricom receives an e-mail of intent from an undisclosed customer to supply 5 MW windmill towers worth about **Rs 55 crore (excl. GST)** by August 2027 _(~1.2% of mcap)_.
**JD Cables** — receives a **Rs 30.43 crore (incl. GST) order** for cables and conductors from an unnamed government and private entity, deliverable within three months _(~7.3% of mcap)_.

**Z-Tech (India)** — receives its first **work orders from Afcons Infrastructure, Rs 10.11 crore (excl. GST)**, for prefabricated drains at MTRN and RE walls on the Dharamtar Creek bridge _(~1.5% of mcap)_.
**Cranex** — receives a **Rs 1.07 crore Letter of Award from South Central Railway, Vijayawada** for a 25/5-tonne EOT crane, due by May 2027 _(~1.4% of mcap)_.
**Waaree Renewable Technologies** — receives a PSU's Letter of Acceptance for turnkey EPC of a 5 MWp grid-connected solar plant, with 10 years of O&M (value not disclosed).
**Mastek** — UK subsidiary is selected by Staffordshire County Council for an Oracle Cloud finance, procurement, HR and payroll programme (value not disclosed).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Evonile Pharma (formerly Novartis India)** — board approves a **partly paid rights issue of up to Rs 900 crore (₹9,000 million)**, subject to a postal ballot; a rights committee will set price, ratio and record date _(~18.1% of mcap)_.
**Shivam Autotech** — sets a **rights issue of up to Rs 120 crore**: up to 10 crore shares at Rs 12, 19 for every 25 held on 15 October, open 22 October to 19 November _(~54.7% of mcap)_.
**Continental Controls** — sets a **Rs 19.67 crore rights issue** of 1,96,68,019 shares at Rs 10, 16 for every 5 held on 14 October, open 29 October to 5 November _(~205% of mcap)_.
**Krsnaa Diagnostics** — receives NSE and BSE in-principle approval for 16,21,000 warrants to its promoter group at Rs 566 each (**Rs 91.75 crore**, our arithmetic) _(~5.3% of mcap)_.

**Technojet Consultants** — calls an EGM on 30 October for up to 5 lakh shares at Rs 48 (**Rs 2.40 crore**), 3.25 lakh of them to Nimesh Sahadeo Singh, who would become promoter and must make an open offer.

**Oseaspre Consultants** — calls an EGM on 30 October for up to 5 lakh shares at Rs 48 (**Rs 2.40 crore**), 3.25 lakh of them to Nimesh Sahadeo Singh, who would become promoter and must make an open offer.

**Innomet Advanced Materials Limited** — In connection with the issue of 11,92,200 (Eleven Lakh Ninety-Two Thousand Two Hundred) Equity Share Warrants on preferential basis, approved by the shareholders of the Company vide Special Resolution
equity_allotments: **Samvardhana Motherson International** — converts 1,45,010 compulsorily convertible debentures from its September 2024 QIP into 10.32 crore shares at Rs 140.50 (**Rs 1,450.10 crore** face value, our arithmetic); 4,990 CCDs remain.

**Purple United Sales** — allots 7,81,750 new shares at Rs 360 (**Rs 28.14 crore**) to non-promoter investors, plus 5,28,500 new warrants at Rs 360 (**Rs 19.03 crore**, 25% paid) to promoter and non-promoter allottees; 44 allottees in all _(~5.7% of mcap)_.

**Centrum Capital** — converts 1,16,87,704 warrants issued in August 2025 into shares at Rs 28.52 for promoter-group entity JBCG Advisory, on receipt of the **Rs 25.00 crore** balance; promoter group rises to 40.86%.
**Ind-Swift Laboratories** — converts 14 lakh of the warrants allotted on 17 September into shares at Rs 196 for promoter Essix Biosciences, on receipt of the **Rs 20.58 crore** balance.

**Ecoboard Industries** — converts 59,41,500 warrants issued in April 2025 into shares at Rs 30 for non-promoter holders, on payment of the 75% balance (**Rs 13.37 crore**, our arithmetic) _(~8.5% of mcap)_.
**Godawari Power & Ispat** — converts 2,72,000 warrants issued in November 2025 into shares at Rs 245 for non-promoter Shree Nakoda Pipe Impex, on receipt of the **Rs 5.00 crore** balance.
m_and_a: **Popees Baby Care India (formerly Hari Govind International)** — board approves buying 99.31% of Popees Baby Care Products via a swap of up to 2.60 crore shares and 98.53 lakh warrants at Rs 142.44 (**Rs 511.33 crore**, our arithmetic), subject to an EGM on 18 November.
**Univastu India** — incorporates UK subsidiary Univastu Networks with **GBP 3.9 million** of capital to acquire the assets of Cambium Networks Ltd, which is in administration.
**TVS Srichakra** — receives **Rs 34.44 crore** for its 7.58% of promoter-group TASL Automobile Solutions at Rs 377.70 a share, as TASL's selective capital reduction takes effect _(~1.0% of mcap)_.
**Sky Industries** — board approves in principle selling its Navi Mumbai factory land and building as it shifts manufacturing to a new Gujarat unit; buyer and price are not yet set.
**Him Teknoforge** — signs a 12-month MoU with Germany's Richard Neumayer GmbH to explore joint markets and a possible stainless-steel forging venture; no monetary value is attached.
capex_core: **Jubilant Pharmova** — Canadian subsidiary Jubilant Draximage will invest **CAD 94.5 million** to expand its Kirkland, Québec plant and double RUBY-FILL capacity, with CAD 23.8 million of Canadian government support.
**WeWork India Management** — leases 1,60,744 sq ft in Pune for about 2,881 desks, operational by July 2027, for an investment of about **Rs 44 crore**.
**Avalon Technologies** — signs a 99-year SIPCOT lease for 25.08 acres at Oragadam, Tamil Nadu, to set up an industrial unit (value not disclosed).
business_updates: **Results season** — 8 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**IRB Infrastructure Developers** — September toll revenue rises about 24% YoY to **Rs 773 crore** from Rs 622 crore; like-for-like growth is 17%, as some projects began tolling only in January-May 2026.
**IRB InvIT Fund** — September gross toll revenue of its seven project SPVs rises about 6% YoY to **Rs 1,401 million** from Rs 1,323 million.
**Embassy Developments** — Q2 FY27 pre-sales of about **Rs 3,225 crore** (Rs 868 crore in Q1) take H1 to Rs 4,093 crore, up ~574% YoY; three launches carry Rs 7,500 crore GDV.
**Keystone Realtors (Rustomjee)** — Q2 FY27 pre-sales reach a record **Rs 14.23 billion, up 84% YoY**, while collections fall 19% to Rs 5.41 billion; H1 pre-sales rise 11% to Rs 20.41 billion.
**Info Edge (India)** — Q2 FY27 standalone billings rise **12.8% YoY to Rs 822.3 crore**, with recruitment up 12.6% and 99acres 21.2%, while Shiksha falls 27.2%.
**P N Gadgil Jewellers** — Q2 FY27 revenue grows **22.4% YoY** although Navratri moved into Q3; retail rises 31.1% on 25.5% same-store growth, while e-commerce falls 83.6% as coin sales are cut.
**NCL Industries** — Q2 FY27 cement dispatches rise **22% YoY to 7,79,428 MT** and production 22% to 7,81,056 MT; H1 dispatches are up 15%.
**Chaman Metallics** — H1 FY27 sponge-iron output rises 24.9% YoY to 79,553 MT and silico-manganese 119.3% to 9,981 MT, but sponge-iron sales fall **43.9% to 35,067 MT**.
**Steel Exchange India** — Q2 FY27 provisional consolidated revenue is about **Rs 340 crore, up ~45% YoY** and ~25% QoQ, on record quarterly re-bar production of 69,465 MT.
**Maiden Forgings** — H1 FY27 revenue from operations grows ~16% YoY to **Rs 127 crore**, with sales volume up ~14.2%, per its press release.
**JSW Steel** — Q2 FY27 consolidated crude steel output rises **5% YoY to 7.27 million tonnes** and 10% QoQ, with Indian operations at 88% utilisation.
**Tata Power** — solar-manufacturing arm TP Solar produces 1 GW of modules and 0.9 GW of cells in Q2 FY27, taking H1 output to 2 GW and 1.8 GW.
**SML Mahindra** — September commercial-vehicle sales rise to **1,071 units from 812** a year earlier and production to 1,257 from 1,049, while exports fall to 53 from 138.
**Muthoot Microfin** — AUM rises 22.0% YoY to **Rs 15,323 crore** at September-end and Q2 FY27 disbursements 28% to Rs 2,900 crore, with collection efficiency at 98.11%.
**Aye Finance** — Q2 FY27 AUM grows 26% YoY and disbursements 10% (15% QoQ), while gross NPA eases 19 bps to 4.30%.

**Fredun Pharmaceuticals** — H1 FY27 update: it has bought 26% of pet pharmacy Goodman Vetcare at a Rs 300 crore valuation and the Furlicks pet-wellness brand from USV; a Palghar utility block is due this month.
**Power Grid Corporation of India** — fully commissions the Bidar (2,500 MW) solar-zone transmission scheme in Karnataka, a TBCB project, with commercial operation from 5 October.
**Kabra Extrusiontechnik** — its GEON new-energy division commissions a 10 MW/20 MWh battery storage project at Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, on an EPC basis.
**Duroply Industries** — the Calcutta High Court sets aside a **Rs 58.28 crore** AY 2018-19 income-tax assessment and remits it for a fresh order _(~54% of mcap)_.
**Pritika Auto Industries** — the Himachal Pradesh High Court quashes a GST order that had rejected its refund claim under the budgetary-support scheme.
**Tata Consumer Products** — the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal, Kolkata, rules in its favour on the AY 2020-21 assessment, including tax depreciation on intangibles.
distress_risk: **BGR Energy Systems** — NCLAT Chennai, hearing its suspended director's appeal against the April insolvency admission, gives the interim resolution professional interim directions; the appeal is next heard on 16 November.
credit_rating_changes: **Mahanagar Telephone Nigam** — Brickwork **upgrades its government-backed bonds to BWR AAA (CE)/Stable from BWR AA+ (CE)** on watch with negative implications; the unsupported rating stays BWR D.
**Asarfi Hospital** — CRISIL **upgrades its bank facilities to BBB/Stable from BBB-/Stable** and assigns A3+, citing higher occupancy and ARPOB.
**Gujarat Ambuja Exports** — CARE reaffirms AA- on its bank facilities and **revises the outlook to Positive from Stable**.
**Zim Laboratories** — CARE reaffirms BBB on its long-term facilities and **revises the outlook to Negative from Stable**.
other_notable: **VRL Logistics** — publishes the public announcement for its **Rs 280 crore tender-offer buyback**, approved by shareholders on 3 October: 87.5 lakh shares (5% of equity) at Rs 320 _(~5.6% of mcap)_.
